
{{alias}}( [options] )
    Returns a value instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object (optional)
        Options.

    options.band: number (optional)
        Multiplication factor for the band width of a scale.

    options.color: Object (optional)
        Color value specifying per-channel references.

    options.exponent: number|Value (optional)
        Scale exponent modifier.

    options.field: string|Object (optional)
        Data field name or descriptor.

    options.mult: number|Value (optional)
        Scale multiplier modifier.

    options.offset: number|Value (optional)
        Scale additive offset.

    options.round: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to round a value after scale transformations.

    options.scale: string|Object (optional)
        Name of scale transform to apply or a field descriptor.

    options.signal: string (optional)
        Signal name or expression.

    options.value: any (optional)
        Constant value.

    Returns
    -------
    value: Value
        Value instance.

    value.band
        Multiplication factor for the band width of a scale.

    value.color
        Color value specifying per-channel references.

    value.exponent
        Scale exponent modifier.

    value.field
        Data field name or descriptor.

    value.mult
        Scale multiplier modifier.

    value.offset
        Scale additive offset.

    value.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    value.round
        Boolean indicating whether to round a value after scale transformations.

    value.scale
        Name of a scale transform to apply or a field descriptor.

    value.signal
        Signal name or expression.

    value.value
        Constant value.

    value.toJSON()
        Serializes a value instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var value = new {{alias}}()
    <Value>

    // Provide options at instantiation:
    > value = new {{alias}}( { 'field': 'price', 'scale': 'xScale' } )
    <Value>
    > value.field
    'price'

    // Set a property:
    > value.signal = 'width';
    > value.signal
    'width'

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > value.toJSON()
    {...}

    See Also
    --------
